name: AthenaBench-Mini
intro: AthenaBench-Mini 是从 8,100 题完整 AthenaBench 中选出的 950 题网络威胁情报基准。构建质量控制按任务分别实施：仅 RCM/VSP 去重、仅 TAA 检查泄漏、仅 CKT 使用 GPT-5/Gemini 筛选并人工修订。作者按各任务规定的抽样率与配额生成 10 个随机种子候选集，并选择整体模型表现最接近完整基准的一组。
org: Rochester Institute of Technology, Athena Security Group
build_method: 任务专属质量控制, 10 个随机种子候选集, 按完整集表现选择代表子集
metric: 准确率（CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA）, 多标签 F1（RMS）, 归一化 MAD 准确率（VSP）, Combined Score
eval_feature: 六类 CTI 任务, 动态威胁数据, 多指标评分, 完整集排名保持抽样
build_method_en: Task-specific quality controls, ten random-seed candidates, representative selection against full-benchmark performance
eval_feature_en: Six CTI tasks, dynamic threat data, multi-metric scoring, full-benchmark ranking-preserving subset selection
intro_en: AthenaBench-Mini is a 950-item subset of the 8,100-item full AthenaBench. Construction controls are task-specific: only RCM/VSP are de-duplicated, only TAA receives leakage checks, and only CKT is screened by GPT-5/Gemini and repaired by humans. The prescribed per-task sampling rates and quotas produce ten random-seed candidates, from which the set whose aggregate model performance is closest to the full benchmark is selected.
scale_en: 950 items (CKT 300, ATE 100, RCM 200, RMS 100, VSP 200, TAA 50)
metric_en: Accuracy (CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA), multi-label F1 (RMS), normalized MAD accuracy (VSP), combined score

drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with AthenaBench arXiv:2511.01144v2 Sections 3.1-3.6, Sections 4.2-4.3, and Tables 1-2. The corrected lanes limit de-duplication to RCM/VSP, leakage checks to TAA, and GPT-5/Gemini screening plus human repair to CKT. The paper-prescribed per-task sampling rates and quotas are applied to ten random-seed Mini candidates; the candidate whose aggregate model performance is closest to the full benchmark is selected. The release is exactly 950 items: 300/100/200/100/200/50 for CKT/ATE/RCM/RMS/VSP/TAA.
